test_goal: Increase conversion rate from 26% to 30%+ by optimizing initial offer language
test_duration: 150 calls per variant (450 calls total, ~2-3 days at current volume)
success_metric: Conversion rate (% of offered who request transfer)

variants.hypothesis: Lead with urgency and scarcity to create FOMO
variants.script: I'm so glad I could help! Before you go, I want to let you know about an exclusive offer we have right now. We're offering a limited-time Hawaii vacation package at a significantly discounted rate - 5 nights in Waikiki for just $699 total, which includes your accommodations and some amazing perks. It's only available for the next few days. Would you be interested in hearing more details about this Hawaii offer?

variants.hypothesis: Shorter script with immediate value prop reduces cognitive load and increases yes rate
variants.script: Great! Quick question before you go - would you be interested in a 5-night Hawaii vacation for only $699? It's a limited-time offer we're extending to you today, and it's an incredible deal. Interested?
variants.rationale: Reduces decision fatigue. Customer hears price + destination immediately. Less overwhelming than long pitch.

variants.hypothesis: Pre-qualifying with a question filters for genuinely interested customers, increasing conversion of those who engage
variants.script: I'm so glad I could help you today! One last thing - have you ever thought about visiting Hawaii? We have an exclusive offer right now for our customers - 5 nights in Waikiki for just $699. It's only available for a few more days. Would you like to hear more about it?
variants.rationale: The 'Have you ever thought about Hawaii?' question creates mental visualization and emotional connection before the offer.

variants.hypothesis: Showing the savings (not just price) emphasizes value and justifies purchase
variants.script: Perfect! Before we wrap up, I want to share something special with you. We're offering 5 nights in Hawaii - normally $1,500 or more - for just $699. That's over 50% off, and it's only available to our customers for the next few days. Would you like to take advantage of this while it's available?
variants.rationale: Showing savings rather than just price makes the value concrete. Comparison to $1,500 makes $699 feel like a steal.

testing_methodology.setup: Deploy 4 versions of the agent with identical flow except Hawaii offer script
testing_methodology.distribution: Route 25% of traffic to each variant randomly
testing_methodology.sample_size: 150 offers per variant (600 total offers ≈ 3-4 days)
testing_methodology.tracking: Use post_call_analysis_data field 'ab_test_variant' to tag each call

method_1_recommended.approach: Create 4 identical agents with only script difference
steps: Clone 'Intro Transfer with Hawaii - IMPROVED' 4 times
Name: 'Hawaii AB Test - Script A' through 'Hawaii AB Test - Script D'
Update node 'node-hawaii-offer' instruction.text with respective script
Route traffic randomly via phone number routing or load balancer

method_2_alternative.approach: Single agent with dynamic script selection via variable
steps: Set to rotate A/B/C/D on each call
Use conditional logic in node instruction

new_field.name: ab_test_variant
new_field.description: Which Hawaii offer script variant was used (for A/B testing)

analysis_query_template.description: Query to run after test completion
analysis_query_template.pseudo_sql: SELECT ab_test_variant, COUNT(*) as offers, SUM(hawaii_transfer_requested) as conversions, (SUM(hawaii_transfer_requested) / COUNT(*)) as conversion_rate, AVG(customer_sentiment) as avg_sentiment FROM calls WHERE hawaii_offered = true AND call_date >= [test_start_date] GROUP BY ab_test_variant ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

decision_criteria.statistical_significance: Use 95% confidence interval, minimum 100 offers per variant
decision_criteria.winner_selection: Variant with highest conversion rate + positive sentiment maintenance
secondary_factors: Does not significantly increase call duration
Maintains or improves objection handling engagement

expected_results.best_case: Script C or D achieves 30-33% conversion (vs 26% baseline)
expected_results.worst_case: All variants perform similarly to baseline (26%)
expected_results.if_worst_case: Test additional variables: timing, tone, voice delivery, or offer structure

rollout_plan_after_test.step_3: Monitor for 1 week to confirm sustained performance
rollout_plan_after_test.step_5: Document learnings for future optimization tests
